name: rotation_cash_sweep_lq1688_20261109
comment: ANCHOR: LQ-20261107-1688 — the cash sweep is a row, not a ticker. /api/v2/rotation/summary
published CASH (Pathward Financial) as its top candidate at 68% concentration, trim 25, with
CASH -> SPCX/NVDA ideas, because positions_current's synthetic per-account cash row
(symbol='CASH', is_cash=true) entered the rotation engine unfiltered and the symbol-card layer
resolved it to a real ticker. The engine now drops cash rows with the repo's one predicate
(lib.holdings_universe.is_cash_row) before enrichment, scoring and idea pairing, while the
denominator stays portfolio_totals.total_value (cash included). Tests run the real engine on
synthetic holdings: the sweep is never a candidate, never card-enriched, never paired; a row
with asset_type=CASH or a known sweep symbol is cash without the flag; a real holding keeps
its 25% weight. No DB, no network.
